name: gfx_device
doc: The host GPU device (GPUDevice) as the recorder knows it (src/gfx/device.ts). Lose: the replayer saw GPUDevice.lost; submissions are still lowered, the replayer executes them against the dead device (nothing is drawn), fences complete. Restore: the embedder gave the replayer a new device: host textures, pipelines and buffers are made again from guest state (gfx_texture Lost, gfx_pipeline Reset). A device lost again before it is restored stays Lost.
